description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AnySoftKeyboardKeyboardSwitchedListener' that manages keyboard switching logic within the AnySoftKeyboard input method. It handles events related to keyboard mode changes, orientation changes, low memory conditions, and input method subtype changes, coordinating with a KeyboardSwitcher instance and maintaining references to current alphabet and symbols keyboards.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardKeyboardSwitchedListener
classes.description: An abstract class that manages keyboard switching events and state within the AnySoftKeyboard input method, implementing the KeyboardSwitchedListener interface to respond to keyboard mode changes, subtype changes, and system events, coordinating with KeyboardSwitcher and maintaining references to current keyboards.

methods.name: createKeyboardSwitcher
methods.description: Creates and returns a new KeyboardSwitcher instance.

methods.name: getKeyboardSwitcher
methods.description: Returns the current KeyboardSwitcher instance.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the keyboard switcher when the service is created.

methods.name: onOrientationChanged
methods.description: Handles orientation changes by flushing keyboard cache.

methods.name: onLowMemory
methods.description: Handles low memory warning by clearing keyboard cache.

methods.name: onAddOnsCriticalChange
methods.description: Responds to critical changes in add-ons by flushing keyboard cache.

methods.name: onAlphabetKeyboardSet
methods.description: Sets the current alphabet keyboard, updates mode, and reports the keyboard ID.

methods.name: onSymbolsKeyboardSet
methods.description: Sets the current symbols keyboard and updates mode.

methods.name: onAvailableKeyboardsChanged
methods.description: Reports available keyboard subtypes.

methods.name: isInAlphabetKeyboardMode
methods.description: Returns whether the current mode is alphabet.

methods.name: getCurrentAlphabetKeyboard
methods.description: Returns the current alphabet keyboard, may be null.

methods.name: getCurrentSymbolsKeyboard
methods.description: Returns the current symbols keyboard, may be null.

methods.name: getCurrentKeyboard
methods.description: Returns the current keyboard based on mode.

methods.name: setKeyboardForView
methods.description: Sets the specified keyboard in the input view.

methods.name: onCurrentInputMethodSubtypeChanged
methods.description: Handles input method subtype changes and may trigger keyboard switch.

methods.name: shouldConsumeSubtypeChangedEvent
methods.description: Determines if a subtype change event should be processed.

methods.name: onSharedPreferenceChange
methods.description: Handles preference changes related to keyboard settings.

methods.name: onCreateInputView
methods.description: Creates and initializes the input view with the keyboard switcher.

methods.name: onKey
methods.description: Handles key press events, including switching to alphabet mode on space.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the service is destroyed.
